subject: Evidence inventory & GRC upload coordination for penetration testing artifacts
messages:
From: Elena Morris <elena.morris@pivotalhealth.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 09:17:00 -0500
Subject: Request: PT artifacts for SIG/CAIQ submission

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for working with Pivotal Health on the SIG intake. Our compliance team needs the penetration testing artifacts that map to the SIG/CAIQ questionnaire: the executive summary, the redacted full report, and an inventory CSV that ties findings to evidence items (screenshots, logs, mitigation tickets).

Can you confirm: 1) whether the report we received last week is the most recent; 2) that you can provide a single evidence inventory file (CSV) showing file names, redaction status, owner, and related Jira or ticket ids; and 3) your estimated ETA for uploading the redacted report + inventory to our GRC portal (link below is where we expect artifacts).

Portal: https://grc.pivotalhealth.com/upload?ref=PH-DH-4721

We need these artifacts by Friday (12/04) to keep our SIG submission on schedule. If any items need additional redaction review, flag them here and we can temporarily accept a redacted executive summary plus a follow-up upload for the full redacted report.

Best,
Elena
Security Compliance Manager
Pivotal Health

Attachments: none

From: jonas.weber@redwood.com <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Morris <elena.morris@pivotalhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 10:02:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Request: PT artifacts for SIG/CAIQ submission

Marissa / Neha — looping you in to coordinate the upload and final redaction check.

On Tue, 01 Dec 2026 at 09:17 Elena Morris <elena.morris@pivotalhealth.com> wrote:
> Hi Jonas,
> 
> Thanks again for working with Pivotal Health on the SIG intake...

Quick status from my side: we have the latest PT report from our vendor (v1.3) and a preliminary inventory CSV prepared by security ops. The report still contains a few internal-only config snippets that should be redacted before portal upload. I propose the following plan:

- Today (12/02): Marissa to run final redaction pass on pivotal_pt_report_v1.3 and confirm sensitive sections list.
- 12/03 morning: Neha to validate the evidence-inventory CSV and add ticket links (Jira IDs).
- 12/04 EOD: Upload redacted PDF + CSV to Pivotal's GRC portal. If upload is blocked, we'll share via a protected Drive folder and send a one-time link.

Please confirm if the timeline works for Pivotal (Elena) and whether they require any specific filename conventions or metadata fields in the CSV (we can add columns: file_name, redaction_status, owner, ticket_id, description).

Action items:
- Marissa: redaction pass (I assigned a checklist in security-runbook).
- Neha: reconcile CSV with Jira and fill ticket_id column.
- Jonas: monitor upload and serve as point-of-contact for any portal issues.

Jonas Weber
Senior Sales Engineer — Security Integrations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: evidence-inventory-20261202-draft.csv (stub)

From: Elena Morris <elena.morris@pivotalhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, jonas.weber@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 03 Dec 2026 08:45:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Request: PT artifacts for SIG/CAIQ submission

Thanks for the plan. A couple of notes from compliance:

- Filename convention: please prefix uploads with PH_PH-DH-4721_ (example: PH_PH-DH-4721_pivotal_pt_report_v1.3_redacted.pdf).
- CSV: we need these columns at minimum: file_name, redaction_status (redacted/partial/unredacted), owner_email, ticket_id, evidence_type (screenshot/log/archive), notes.
- If the portal rejects PDFs > 20MB, please provide a Drive link and set the GRC upload entry to "link".

We'll accept the executive summary first if the full redacted report requires legal review; just mark that in the CSV. Our intake deadline is Friday EOD (12/04) but we can accept a final confirmation by Monday (12/07) if you need the extra time — please flag any blockers.

Portal upload page: https://grc.pivotalhealth.com/upload?ref=PH-DH-4721

Regards,
Elena

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morris <elena.morris@pivotalhealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, jonas.weber@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 05 Dec 2026 14:22:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Request: PT artifacts for SIG/CAIQ submission — upload complete

Elena — quick update and confirmation.

We completed the redaction pass and validated the inventory. Uploaded artifacts to your portal this morning and updated the intake record with the following files:

- PH_PH-DH-4721_pivotal_pt_report_v1.3_redacted.pdf (redaction: full, redaction_note: removed internal config blocks, ~7.8MB)
- PH_PH-DH-4721_evidence-inventory-20261205.csv (columns: file_name, redaction_status, owner_email, ticket_id, evidence_type, notes)
- PH_PH-DH-4721_remediation-status-20261205.xlsx (summary of open findings and ETA per ticket)

Drive link (in case portal link is slow): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C_grc-evidence

A couple of housekeeping items:
- Open findings are in Jira under keys: SEC-2389 (medium), SEC-2394 (low). We expect SEC-2389 to be closed after the release scheduled for 12/10.
- If your audit team requires the unredacted report under an NDA, please let us know and we'll coordinate a secured transfer.

Jonas will remain the point-of-contact for any portal issues; Neha retains the inventory master in case you need additional crosswalks to other questionnaires.

Thanks — we should be good for SIG intake but will monitor and respond to any follow-ups from your intake team.

Best regards,
Marissa Cole
Director, Security Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: PH_PH-DH-4721_evidence-inventory-20261205.csv (stub), PH_PH-DH-4721_remediation-status-20261205.xlsx (stub)
